problems_fixed.what: Duplicate solution within bronze: B7 (n^2+1, 4th term) and B5 (which term = 50) both answered 17. Changed nth term n^2+1 -> n^2+2 so the 4th term is 18. Recomputed both misconception expects (16, 10) and the guided walk.

opener_concept: Cafe tables pushed into a row: 1 table seats 4, each extra table adds 2 seats (6, 8, ...). The fixed +2 is named as the common difference and the rule 2n+2 as the nth term, so a student sees an arithmetic sequence before any algebra.
